Needs changes before merge.

The group edits the page draft through the existing form helper. Apply uses the existing undoable command. The change stays within the UI crate. The partial issue reference and the decision entry describe the slice clearly.

Results, locally:

- PR head: `6f0e8eaeb7c1ad8a1fe20e29be60741e98ff44c1`.
- Base: current `upstream/main`, `209f62665a6eb99fc565622558af25963483f778`.
- Trial merge: `67db4257492a6ab0f81ba594dd2733f2a5802888`. The merge is clean. Its first parent is the PR head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 10 steps, 2 failed. The UI build and UI library steps fail to compile.
- The eight UI integration suites pass: `boundary` (3), `boundary_picks` (7), `contour_dxf_sketch` (2), `sinker_setup` (2), `tap_hand` (3), `theme_example` (3), `theme_files` (17), and `waterjet_tool` (1). Total: 38 tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: fails with the same two compiler errors.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 3 steps passed, 0 failed. Both light tests pass: `the_slot_keeps_its_verdict_under_sub_micron_perturbations_light` and `wide_rectangular_pocket_is_cleared_by_parallel_lanes_light`.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: the diff reaches no heavy lane.

Compiler errors:

```text
error[E0063]: missing field `corner_relief` in initializer of `camcraft_app::operation::OpParams`
  --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/predrilled_page_tests.rs:34:5

error[E0063]: missing field `source` in initializer of `camcraft_app::machining2d::RestParams`
   --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/predrilled_page_tests.rs:164:16
```

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/predrilled_page_tests.rs:34` and `:164`: update both test fixtures for current upstream/main. Supply `corner_relief` and `source` with the intended values. Run the UI library tests and clippy again. The new pinning tests cannot run on this trial merge.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/predrilled_page.rs:24` / PR body: add before/after screenshots for the changed Pocket lead tab. The body has no screenshots. Show the new group and its enabled contents. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body.

Extra suites run: none beyond the quick and light plans. The diff changes no test data, fixture directories, importers, posts, motion code, or catalog. The extra kernel and example catalog suites do not apply.

Mutations: not run. This slice adds a UI control for an existing parameter. It changes no posting, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry implementation. The new UI tests cannot compile against the current base. No goldens moved. No pixel snapshots ran.

The verdict is `needs-rework`. The PR remains a draft. The review worktree and branch remain in place for the next round.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

- The Pocket fixture sets `corner_relief` and `pass_start` to their defaults. The rest fixture sets `source` to `RestSource::EnteredTool`.
- Each field removal fails compilation with E0063. After restoration, all three `egui_app::predrilled_page_tests` pass. They pin the group location, undoable Apply, and the rest refusal.
- The PR body now links before/after Pocket lead screenshots. The after image shows the enabled group and its contents. The images are only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch, at `03edacff2d61c113551f31c9e40168f044e578c3`.

New head: `9dd166f05df1c4cebfd1255c43bda69ecfb2c50c`.

Final checks use current `upstream/main`, `74ea8988d800f00d41547ec9d292077d2bc3ddc5`:

- Quick gate: 10 steps, 0 failed. UI library: 1479 passed, 8 ignored. UI integration suites: 38 passed.
- UI clippy, all targets with `-D warnings`: passed.
- Heavy gate: 0 steps, 0 failed. The diff reaches no heavy lane.
- Example catalog: 37 passed, 4 ignored, 0 failed. No goldens moved.

Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft. The warm fix worktree remains in place.

Coordinator, second read and merge note for head 9dd166f05df1c4cebfd1255c43bda69ecfb2c50c. Class: no refresh (the head is the reviewed head).

## Second read (read-only): no blocker
- The group edits the page draft only. Apply uses the existing undoable command; the test checks undo and redo.
- The group shows one switch, `links.approach.predrilled`, which is on `main` from the first slice (#1493) for MCP and the project file. This PR does not add a way to plunge. A hole is used only when a Drill operation before the pocket made it, the drill is large enough for the tool, and the stock of the program before it shows the hole open down to the floor. If not, the pocket keeps its normal entry and names the reason. I see no gouge risk from this slice.
- The strings are plain English. Three behaviour tests are new; none is deleted. No PNG is in the tree. The before and after images are in the body. No `unwrap` or `expect` outside tests.
- Notes, filed as https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3586: `mill2d_page.rs` grows by one line (416; the body says 398), and the switch has no tooltip.

## Merge
This merge relies on:
- the review of 00:11Z on this head (marker in the review), with a built trial merge on `main` 74ea8988d: the whole quick plan, 10 steps, `ui suites: lib` 1479 passed and 8 ignored, clippy on `camcraft-ui`, and `example_catalog` 37 passed;
- 74ea8988d is the tip of `main` now, so that trial is the trial on the current `main`;
- this second read.

The heavy plan reaches no lane for this diff. It is a `feat`: it merges when it is reviewed and gated.
